display_title: If That What You Want, I'll Gladly Do It
mangabaka_title: If That What You Want, I'll Gladly Do It

titles.title: If That What You Want, I'll Gladly Do It

description:
“Could you stay with me?”     
“You’re being rather direct.”     
“In return, I’ll take whatever happens tonight to my grave.”     
“……Gladly, if you want.” 

On the day she was demoted and transferred after taking the blame for her division director’s mistake, Seojin, while carrying out a small act of revenge, proposed a one-night stand to a man she had just met. She thought it would end there—as nothing more than a single night of reckless escape…… but after a misunderstanding, she ended up meeting him again at her new workplace… as her boss. And not just any boss—he was Kim Junha, Vice Chairman of TH Group!
